description: Update metadata or pricing on a draft OR active listing. The correct API route is chosen from the listing's current status. To change the price of a live listing pass price (USD) or price_cents.

price.description: Price in USD (e.g. 19). Mutually exclusive with price_cents.

price_cents.description: Price in integer cents (e.g. 1900 = $19.00). Mutually exclusive with price.

pricing_type.description: Pricing model. Inferred as buy_it_now when a positive price is given; defaults to free only when no price is supplied.

name: update_listing
